claims.claim: Used 3 Seaters and 2 Seaters Couch going for giveaway price
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black tufted 2-seater sofa only; no evidence of a 3-seater or any pricing context in the images.

risks.risk: Unclear upholstery material and wear level (e.g., velvet/fabric vs leather; hidden stains/marks not visible in the limited angles).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the upholstery surface (front seat area, both armrests, and backrest) in good light, plus a photo of any visible stains/marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for a used fabric sofa with possible hidden stains/marks: treat as not fully clean/unknown upholstery condition.

risks.risk: Seat sagging or weak foam not reliably shown by wrinkling/creases in photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the seller pressing down on the seat cushion and releasing it to demonstrate bounce-back, plus a side-angle showing cushion depth.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially sagging/low-firmness: treat as worn comfort/foam condition.

risks.risk: Frame/leg stability issues (gold legs could be loose or wobble; not testable from photos).
risks.proof: A clip where the sofa is gently rocked from the front and side to show whether it wobbles; close-up of leg-to-frame joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly unstable/needs tightening: treat as unknown frame condition.

risks.risk: Damage to seams, piping, or buttoning (tufted buttons and seams can hide tears or loose stitching).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tufted seams/buttons and the edges/underside seams (where visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown seam integrity: treat as could have minor seam/button wear.

risks.risk: Dimensions/true capacity mismatch (photos say 2-seater, but exact size and whether it’s truly a compact 2-seater vs wider sofa is not shown).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape showing total length and seat width, plus seat height from the floor.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for value: treat as smaller/less usable than expected if dimensions can’t be confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of upholstery (seat, both arms, backrest) showing any stains/marks.
Send a short video of pressing the seat cushion and showing bounce-back.
Send a video showing the sofa rocked gently to confirm leg/frame stability.
Send close-ups of tufted buttons/seams and the sofa edges/underside seams.
Send measurements (total length, seat width, seat height) with a measuring tape.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a black tufted 2-seater sofa, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller’s “3-seater” and “giveaway price” statements are not supported by the photos, so pricing should assume unknown wear and potential hidden issues.
